title: On Exact Bit-level Reversible Transformers Without Changing Architecture
reviewed_version: publisher proceedings version at retrieval; immutable local SHA-256
inspection_outcome: One Major finite-arithmetic guarantee defect; exact-integer repair verified
summary: Fixed-grid precision alone does not imply error-free finite floating additions; collision uses no overflow and satisfies grid invariant. Algebraic integer identity survives. Empirical arithmetic supported; actual implementation unavailable.
limitations: No author code or training execution; no new downloads or installations.
Finite-arithmetic witnesses establish missing range conditions, not historical run failure.
No independent rerun or raw logs/checkpoints.
No later full-text correction or independent erratum search.

problems.title: Fixed-grid precision does not certify finite-machine bitwise reversibility
problems.claim: Quantization and parity side information guarantee exact bit-level inversion because fixed-grid terms incur no arithmetic error.
problems.assumptions: l9,gamma+.5,x0=0 or2delta,h0=-x,x1=0,s0=0,h1 constant; deterministic standard IEEE round-to-nearest arithmetic; all stored states satisfy Q(x)=x; no overflow.
problems.check: Parent independently operation-rounded binary16/32/64 forward collisions and inverse failure; verified exact-integer inverse analytically and on40602 combinations.
problems.result: At binary16 B12, delta=2^-9 is quarterULP; x2=12 forboth inputs, same sidebit, inverse0. Analogous binary32 B98304 andbinary64 B3*2^44.
problems.counterevidence: Exact unbounded-grid identity and Proposition4.3 parity algebra valid. Figure2 zero-error experimental trace may stay in safe range. No claim of historicalrun failure or authorimplementationbug.
problems.impact: Demonstrated invalid numerical derivation directly supports central exact reconstruction and gradient-equivalence guarantee.
problems.correction: Exact-integer representation and range-checked intermediates suffice; actual arithmetic/range/replay implementation still unverified.

repair_verification.P1: Exact-integer inverse proved and40602 cases checked; finite-width representability condition explicit; actual implementation not verified
